withdrawals.q203_no_faithful_one: Comment 6880918908 withdraws the Q203 phrase 'exactly one fiber-weight family … and no faithful one' from comment 6880442727. E0 remains the unique expectation preserving Iν for ν>0 on Y, and E0 preserves no faithful state. Other mathematical expectations, including E_av, are constructible in the counting diagnostic.
withdrawals.q201_no_ky: Comment 6880442727 accepts that Q201's sentence 'the source types no k_y' was too broad. E0 is the inherited point-mass expectation and is not faithful.
withdrawals.a1_existence_wording: Comment 6881613050 says A1 should no longer be described as failing because no inherited mathematical expectation, faithful expectation, or tower-compatible family exists. Effect selection and enactment stay SUPPLIED.
withdrawals.stage_comparison_sentence: Comment 6882809112 withdraws the sentence 'Any read that registers the event must compare stage t with t+1.' Stage memory is not a prerequisite. A6 is stopped.
withdrawals.q206_credit: Q206 is scoped to linear scalar families satisfying ell_X=ell_Y P_XY and is credited to seeded T-002 A1-A3. The local novelty kept is the explicit coefficient form.
withdrawals.premise_ii: Comment 6885358017 narrows premise (ii) from global R to the owner-row law. Global R remains one sufficient route. The owner-row law stays SUPPLIED.
withdrawals.q224_permanent_ledger: Comment 6901702486, Dot, says Q224's requirement that an owner fact need r_* plus the identity on the whole ledger overstated a sufficient realization. Permanent ledger protection is an extra implementation condition. Comment 6901766104 accepts that narrowing.
withdrawals.q224_injectivity: Comment 6901766104 withdraws the injectivity type-opposite explanation. v15.10 section IV states only the absence of a frozen pruning-to-successor identification. The bounded V995-V997 verdict is unchanged.
withdrawals.q225_cone_total_wording: Comment 6903344711 says Q225's fiber expression should be described as obtained from retained cone totals, not as equal to the p-cone total in general. Comment 6904631563 concedes that wording. Q225's no-admitted-candidate conclusion is unaffected.
withdrawals.q232_actuality: Comment 6905341174 withdraws the Q232 sentence that identifying the owner is necessary to make the response an actual event. The adopted wording is Dot's in 6904848541: under a strict-record encoding of both coverage steps, their view representations have opposite inclusion behavior, and their association with source and receiver remains to be derived.
withdrawals.q236_any_operation: Comment 6906623608 withdraws the Q236 sentence that any inherited or supplied operation assigning the retained excluded sector assigns it to an owner blind to that selection. The one-index fixed-other-record statement stands.
withdrawals.q237_erasure_scope: Comment 6907564641 accepts that common-mode by erasure refers only to the all-V record/view channel. The accepted P1 grade distinction is not erased.
withdrawals.q240_event_typing: Comment 6908422349 corrects Q240. Typing the actual event as the maximal one-address retraction is too strong for a localized source. The point condition is weaker than the owner-row law. Event typing and availability stay supplied.
withdrawals.q247_chain_equivalence: Comment 6912174012 withdraws the identification, in 6911549545, of the compatible-chain rule with fiber-membership delivery. The chain rule is a supplied record-outcome correlation.
withdrawals.q249_state_grade: Comment 6913463114 scopes Q249 to a supplied normalized state-grade model. It does not close the retained-source consumer route.
withdrawals.q250_only_after_p1: Comment 6915477631 withdraws Q250's sentence that the types match only after P1. The conditioning identity does not remove initial blindness or equation (11).
withdrawals.q254_unposted: Comment 6918741978 withdraws an unposted Q254 note as a duplicate of receiver-identification proposition 26.1 and theorem 26.3. There is no posted comment numbered Q254.
withdrawals.q260_provenance: Comment 6921054290 is a provenance correction to 6920480815. The move-versus-copy statement restates record-access theorem 5.1 and corollary 5.3 and claims nothing new. The read-table-versus-retraction statement remains.
withdrawals.q264_unit_freeness: Comment 6924346252 withdraws the Q264 sentence that unit-freeness is determined by inherited projective typing, after GPT Q265 in 6924145346. Unit-freeness remains assumed. Proposition 264.2 and the availability limit stand.
